verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that New Relic dashboards are built in the UI with tailored, high-density interactive visualizations charted via NRQL, and that they can be shared, including through public live dashboard URLs. However, nothing in the evidence documents template variables or the range of visualization types, and the dashboards-as-code angle is unevidenced. missing for 10: template variables, enumerated rich visualization types, dashboards-as-code (API/Terraform dashboard definitions), independent hands-on corroboration.
